answer: Agents can earn transaction privileges only after locking a scarce, nontransferable stake for a cooling-off period; each identity must lock its own stake, and slashing burns it when linked accounts coordinate fraud. This makes a haven for honest trade harder to fake than a name: splitting one operator across many identities multiplies capital requirements and leaves funds unavailable. An opal seller entering through a new inlet faces the same rule, so an attacker must risk real resources for every Sybil identity.
